output_list.reason: Contract allow the purchase of tokens if msg.value >= minContribution. Attacker can buy tokens and do transaction gas-free and then call distribute tokens in multiple transactions. This would lead to unfair distribution of tokens to the contributors.
Distribution of tokens are not limited. This could lead to huge token balance for certain users which is against the ICO concept of token distribution to the contributors only.
Function transfer allows anyone to transfer any amount of token to any address which is not controlled by any user. This could be used for malicious purpose.
Function transferFrom allows anyone to transfer token from the owner's account to any address which is not controlled by any user. This could be used for malicious purpose.
